notes.title: Free of charge soon
notes.notes:
Thank to those who have participated in the development of the game and to those who supported us.

Supralympic Runners is our first game project that represents thousands of hours of hard work.
An artisanal production made by childhood friends, with the help of people from the Toulouse video game development community.

Today we decide to offer the game.

We are no longer active in the creation of video games, and the development of Supralympic Runners have been stopped since 2019.

Have fun on the track!

notes.title: Supralympics Update !
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32707816/4642fbaa14a777014c4006ea390fa1c45da6526e.jpg[/img]

Big upgrade today! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]What's new in content[/h1]
[list][*]Create the profile of your runner (planet, age, nation)
[*]3 scales of competition : national, planetary and interplanetary
[*]3 scales of difficulty : amateur, pro, elite
[*]Adaptative music by Masami Komuro ~小室雅己~
[*]Environment dynamic evolution : corridors and cityscapes (3 biomes)
[*]Obstacles reskined : slime spitter, electric fields and compressor[/list]
[h1]WARNING[/h1]

notes.title: Customisation Update !
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32707816/7b65f209fdfbd5150458f80653302ed20c0318c9.jpg[/img]

Supralympic Runners has now:
[list]
[*]an [b]XP system[/b]: the more you run, the more you run!
[*][b]Uracoins![/b] It's the runner money. You get it reaching checkpoints, and multiply them with collectibles during the races!
[*]a freakin [b]WORKSHOP[/b] where you can use Uracoins to customise your runner with high-performance and expensive gears!
[*]a deep [b]variation of every physical aspects[/b] of the game though the gears: resilience, impulse, density,  aerodynamics, etc.
[*]a better [b]slow down system[/b]: separated from the slow motion, it's now a full feature by itself. When you slow down, you get back some dash power to get back your speed afterward!
[*]a better [b]vertical control[/b]: you can plane very smoothly when holding the jump button, and can get back to the ground faster. You can control your jump lenght!
[/list]
We kinda drive away from a classical endless runner to steal some ideas from sports cars games - however Supalympics stays an arcade game. The customisation update is the biggest update we wanted to make before the release. Can you feel the heat?!
